title: Webhook Trigger Node
description: Workflow entry point triggered by incoming HTTP POST requests from external systems. Supports optional JSON Schema payload validation.

webhook_path.description: Unique URL slug identifying this webhook endpoint (e.g., 'jira-updates'). Becomes part of the final URL: /api/v1/webhooks/{webhook_path}

input_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema (Draft-07) for validating incoming webhook payloads. If set, requests with non-conforming payloads are rejected with 422 Unprocessable Content.

authorized_service_account_ids.description: UUIDs of service accounts authorized to invoke this webhook trigger endpoint

resultSchema.description: Trigger result is the validated webhook request body passed through directly

oneOf.title: Failed Result
oneOf.description: Trigger failure output for reporting purposes
